task.description: Quick re-confirmation, not a full re-review. After your PASS on step-04 (commit c1b8bccb), REVIEWER's own gate (step-05) FAILed on an idiom finding and routed a REWORK back to ELIXIR-DEV: role_registry.ex previously used bare opts[:prefix] inline; it now binds `prefix = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :prefix)` once per function (list_roles/1, do_upsert_role/3, insert_or_update_role/3) and uses that variable at each Repo call site (commit 4724703f, this branch). This is a mechanical variable-binding change, not a behavioral one -- same prefix value reaches the same Repo calls, just via a local variable instead of a repeated keyword-list lookup, and Keyword.fetch! now RAISES on a missing :prefix instead of silently returning nil (a strictly stronger guarantee against the same cross-tenant leak class than the code you already passed). Confirm by direct diff (git show 4724703f -- lib/letflow/identity/role_registry.ex) that: (a) every Repo call site that previously carried prefix: opts[:prefix] now carries prefix: prefix (the bound variable), with no call site losing its prefix argument; (b) no new Repo call was introduced; (c) the Keyword.fetch! change is strictly safer than opts[:prefix] for INV-1 (raises rather than silently defaulting to public schema on a missing key), not a weakening. Work in worktree c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\letflow-wf03-iss0768, branch feature/WF03-ISS0768-20260921. Hard rule: never push directly to main.
acceptance_criteria: Diff of commit 4724703f confirmed to preserve prefix: at every Repo call site (no call site regressed to unscoped)
Confirmed no new Repo call site introduced by this rework

result.summary: Re-confirmed via direct diff of commit 4724703f that the REVIEWER-driven rework (bare opts[:prefix] -> bound `prefix = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :prefix)` per function) preserves prefix scoping at every Repo call site in list_roles/1, do_upsert_role/3 (Repo.get/3 and Repo.transaction/2), and insert_or_update_role/3 (Repo.insert/2) -- no call site regressed to unscoped. No new Repo call introduced (grep confirms only pre-existing Repo.all/get/transaction/insert calls plus the untouched resolve_role_in_tx/1 Repo.get_by/2, which never took a prefix opt and relies on documented ambient transaction context from the caller). Keyword.fetch! is a strengthening of INV-1, not a weakening: it raises loudly on a missing :prefix key instead of opts[:prefix]'s silent nil-default to the public/unscoped schema -- the exact cross-tenant leak class INV-1 guards against.
